description: This Java class provides utility methods to generate random strings, possibly for password resets or user verification tokens. It contains methods to generate random strings with or without numeric characters and relies on the java.util.Random class.

classes.name: UserReset
classes.description: A utility class for generating random strings, used for password reset tokens or similar purposes.

methods.name: generateRandomString
methods.description: Generates a random string of fixed length (10), using characters from CHAR_LIST_WITHNUM.

methods.name: generateRandomString
methods.description: Generates a random string of specified length, using characters from CHAR_LIST.

methods.name: getRandomNumber
methods.description: Returns a random index within the bounds of the character list for string generation.
